Questions:
- Can you confirm whether this can be included under our upcoming renewal (same account, one contract amendment)?
- Lead time for appliance shipment and onsite install window (we're in US-West) — target go-live early Jan.
- Any implications for SLA/uptime or maintenance windows if we add physical appliances?

Also attaching our initial procurement checklist (see referenced BOM later).

Appreciate a proposal and a rough cost delta so we can budget for the renewal call next week.

Thanks,
Julia

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front: yes, we can fold appliance hardware into the renewal as an amendment; typical shipment lead time is 6-8 weeks after PO/approval for standard build, and we can offer an accelerated 3-week path for an expedited fee.

I've attached a draft SOW that outlines scope, BOM, install assumptions, and a proposed maintenance calendar. Key notes: 
- Appliances will be provisioned as part of your Private deployment with network-level isolation and dedicated node pools.
- We'll need a 4 hour weekly maintenance window (we can cluster those to low-traffic nights) — if you need no weekly windows we can use a monthly 6 hour window instead for a small SLA credit.
- Onboarding includes 2 on-site days for install & verification (optional — remote guided install available).

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal review with our solutions team (I'll loop in Dev).
2) Confirm preferred install option (remote vs onsite) and desired lead time.
3) Ben -> pricing & amendment -> Julia sign (DocuSign).

I copied Kimberly to coordinate commercial terms. Attachments: SOW_Infratech_v1.2.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_BOM_kitlist.csv (text/csv).

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-16T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Appliance fleet add — need pricing cadence + install plan

Ben / Kimberly — scope and ops notes below. Long tail details attached (maintenance_calendar.ics stub).

Capacity / ops plan:
- Node sizing: each rack node supports ~1.2M tokens/min with current model mix; 3 nodes + 2 spares gives ~3.6M sustained tokens/min with 40% burst headroom.
- Network isolation: appliances will join customer VPC via transit gateway/PrivateLink with explicit ACLs. We'll provision a segregated node pool and dedicated routing to avoid cross-tenant KV leakage.
- Maintenance: suggest weekly 02:00-06:00 PT windows for patch/firmware; alternate option: single monthly 06:00-12:00 PT window for minimal impact. SLA credit of 0.25% annual uptime available if they select monthly-only window.
- Onsite: EdgeWorks has certified field engineers in US-West; 2-day install + 1-day acceptance testing.

Lead time & options:
- Standard: 6-8 weeks from signed amendment + PO.
- Expedited: 3 weeks (subject to component availability) + 15% expedite surcharge.

I've attached: maintenance_calendar.ics (text/calendar) and a quick BOM mapping. If approved I'll mark installers and provide exact ship dates.

—Dev
Attachment: maintenance_calendar.ics (text/calendar)
